visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair and bangs stands in front of a plain white wall, wearing a light pink short-sleeved button-down shirt. She smiles and gestures towards Singapore and Malaysia flag overlays appearing on either side of her chest level. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her facial expressions. (2) The woman holds up a pair of black platform Chelsea-style boots towards the camera, turning them to show the thick soles and side elastic. A text label appears at the top left. The scene cuts to her wearing the boots while modeling a beige and white tank top with black shorts in the same studio setting. (3) She presents a medium-sized brown leather shoulder bag with a gold clasp. She demonstrates how to hold it by the top handle and then wear it on her shoulder. The scene cuts to her wearing a brown tank top and green cargo pants while showcasing the bag. A close-up shows the interior of the bag being packed with a power bank and wallet. (4) The woman holds a small pink jar of moisturizing cream labeled 'Glad2Glow'. She opens the lid to reveal a white spatula and the creamy product inside. She applies a small amount of the pinkish-translucent gel to the back of her hand and then gently rubs it onto her left cheek, demonstrating the texture. (5) She holds up a large red oversized t-shirt with 'WORLDWIDE AGAINST' printed on the back in bold white and black letters. She transitions to wearing the shirt, doing a 360-degree turn to show the front graphics and the large back design. (6) She holds up a brown and white horizontal striped tube top. She first models it as a top tucked into black shorts, then shifts the framing to show it worn as a mini-skirt over her shorts, paired with a brown tank top. (7) Returning to a medium close-up, the woman looks directly into the camera, cup her hands around her mouth as if shouting a question, and points downward towards an invisible comment section. The flags from the first phase reappear briefly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic female voice begins speaking with a rising intonation, introducing a travel shopping haul. An upbeat, major-key electronic pop BGM with a steady 115 BPM kick drum starts simultaneously. (2) As the speaker transitions to the first product, a 'ding' sound effect triggers a change in vocal energy to an enthusiastic descriptive tone. Low-level fabric rustling is audible as items are handled. (3) A soft 'pop' sound effect occurs when the bag is mentioned. The speaker's pitch remains consistently high and friendly. The BGM remains a constant, light synthesized texture underneath. (4) The speaker's pace increases as she describes skincare ingredients. A subtle clicking sound of a plastic lid opening is heard. A 'sparkle' SFX plays when she mentions the brightening effect. (5) Vocal delivery remains rapid-fire with very short pauses between sentences. Sounds of fabric rustling increase as clothes are displayed. (6) A final 'pop' SFX accompanies the closing call-to-action. The voice adopts a teasing, inquisitive contour at the very end. The BGM fades out quickly after the final word.
